newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil mulls offering cheaper credit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil mulls offering cheaper credit - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Finance Ministry wants to offer below-market-rate loans to medium-sized businesses which will be able to use the money to finance cash flow, Economic Policy Secretary Jose Roberto Mendonca de Barros said in a newspaper interview published on Tuesday.

Under the plan, the National Development Bank (BNDES) would issue debentures to institutional investors and use the funds for low-interest loans to medium-sized businesses, Mendonca de Barros told O Globo newspaper.
Currently, BNDES offers subsidized loans to medium-sized firms only if they use the money for investment, not to finance their cash flows.
The idea must be approved by Brazil's National Monetary Council, Mendonca de Barros said.
